title: Fix magic-item Ring description contamination
description: PR #150 review feedback: the magic-item exact-name gate passes, but generated Ring descriptions are cross-contaminated by neighboring entries because the Magic Items A-Z parser slices a flat page body from category end to next name start. Fix body assignment and add committed-pack regression assertions for Ring of Feather Falling, Ring of Evasion, Ring of Free Action, Ring of Invisibility, Ring of Jumping, and Ring of Mind Shielding.
notes:
Evidence: committed records.json currently reproduces the review. Ring of Feather Falling includes acid resistance / earth movement Elemental Command bullets; Ring of Free Action includes stone shape/stoneskin/wall of stone plus Fire Elemental Command text; Ring of Invisibility includes fire resistance/Ignan/fire immunity text; Ring of Jumping includes burning hands/fireball/wall of fire and Water Elemental Command text; Ring of Mind Shielding includes water elemental/breathe underwater/create or destroy water text; Ring of Evasion includes neighboring telepathic/jump spell fragments. Exact name-set assertions still pass because the record keys/names are present.
RED: npx vitest run packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts fails on the new committed-pack Ring body assignment test. First failure: Ring of Feather Falling description contains the leaked phrase 'resistance to acid damage'. This proves exact-name coverage does not catch body corruption.
Root cause: extractPdfText chose a page-column cut by largest accepted x-gap. On SRD p236, two far-right words inside the right column (the split 'jump spell') formed a wider gap than the real page gutter and satisfied the minimum count/distinct-x guards. The extractor therefore left the real left/right columns merged in y-row order; parseMagicItems then sliced each body from category end to next name start across that interleaved text, contaminating Ring descriptions. Confirmed fix direction: rank candidate gutters by stronger smaller-side item support, using gap width only as a tiebreaker; page 236 then emits Elemental Command text, Ring of Evasion, and the short Ring entries in correct reading order.
Result: npm run import:dnd5e-srd after the first extractor scoring change failed with EquipmentColumnMismatchError: Gear table column mismatch left=20 right=0. The fix is too broad and changes another parser's expected extraction shape. Returning to root-cause tracing for the changed extractor behavior before regenerating the pack.
Result: after scoped extractor fix and committed-pack regeneration, Ring records are clean, but git diff exposed additional Magic Items A-Z body-boundary changes on p247-p248. Some are corrections (Trident of Fish Command, Universal Solvent, Wand descriptions), but Vicious Weapon now includes Vorpal Sword text, so body assignment still needs parser-level boundary protection before final verification.
close_reason: Fixed Magic Items A-Z body contamination by rejecting tiny far-right outlier column cuts on SRD p236, recognizing wrapped-rarity category starts, regenerating the committed SRD pack with 237 magic items including Vorpal Sword, and adding committed-pack regressions for affected Ring records plus Vicious/Vorpal. Verification passed: focused vitest 72 tests, verify:dnd5e-srd-pack, npm run check, npm run typecheck, npm run test.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Review item: Magic Items A-Z generated descriptions are cross-contaminated by neighboring Ring entries while exact-name coverage still passes. Evaluation: accepted. Evidence to verify: committed pack Ring records should not include unrelated Ring of Elemental Command or neighboring ring text; current flat category-end to next-name slice is likely unsafe for interleaved two-column SRD pages. Plan: add committed-pack regression assertions first, reproduce RED, then fix parser body assignment and regenerate the committed pack.
